The Bears, members of the [[Big 12 Conference]], played their home games at the [[Ferrell Center]] in [[Waco, Texas]]. They were led by 20th-year head coach [[Scott Drew]]. They finished the season 23–11, 11–7 in [[2022–23 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 Play]] to finish a tie for 3rd place. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2023 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 Tournament]] to [[2022–23 Iowa State Cyclones men's basketball team|Iowa State]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2023 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA Tournament]] where they defeated [[2022–23 UC Santa Barbara Gauchos men's basketball team|UC Santa Barbara]] in the First Round before losing in the Second Round to [[2022–23 Creighton Bluejays men's basketball team|Creighton]]. ==Previous season== The [[2021–22 Baylor Bears basketball team|Bears]] finished the [[2021–22 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2021–22 season]] 27–7, 14–4 in [[2021–22 Big 12 Conference men's basketball season|Big 12 play]] to finish a tie for the regular season championship. They lost in the quarterfinals of the [[2022 Big 12 men's basketball tournament|Big 12 tournament]] to [[2021–22 Oklahoma Sooners men's basketball team|Oklahoma]]. They received an at-large bid to the [[2022 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]] as the No. 1 seed in the East Region, where they defeated [[2021–22 Norfolk State Spartans men's basketball team|Norfolk State]] in the first round before getting upset in the second round by [[2021–22 North Carolina Tar Heels men's basketball team|North Carolina]]. ==Offseason==
